name: Mahou Shoujo Inori ~Ishukan Haramase Mugen Ingoku~
original_name: 魔法少女イノリ～異種姦孕ませ・無限淫獄～
source:
Inori was a smart, slightly cool girl living an ordinary school life.
One day, out of nowhere, she found herself face-to-face with a horrifying monster attack.
As she teetered on the edge of passing out, a strange little creature appeared before her.
"Become a magical girl right now and save them!"
Without thinking, Inori transformed and began taking down the monsters one by one…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx/work/=/product_id/VJ012164.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
伊织是个聪明而略显冷淡的女孩，过着普通的校园生活。
某天，她毫无征兆地面对了一场可怕的怪物袭击。
就在她即将昏倒时，一个奇怪的小生物出现在面前。

“现在就成为魔法少女，拯救他们！”

伊织不假思索地变身，开始逐个击倒怪物……

（译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx/work/=/product_id/VJ012164.html/]DLsite[/url]）
